name: SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  version-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyyaml
      - name: Validate version
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_version.py

  generate-sdk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyyaml
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: |
          uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate

  publish-python:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install setuptools wheel twine
      - name: Build package
        run: |
          python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel
      - name: Publish package
        run: |
          twine upload dist/*

  publish-typescript:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install --global pnpm
          pnpm install
      - name: Type check
        run: |
          pnpm run typecheck
      - name: Build package
        run: |
          pnpm run build
      - name: Publish package
        run: |
          pnpm publish --access public
